About a year and a half into his second term, President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Utah voters continues to be underwater.

A new Deseret News/Hinckley Institute of Politics poll,.pdf " conducted by Morning Consult, found Utah voters generally aren’t happy with the way Trump has handled his return to the White House. It’s a trend seen in nationwide polling, too, despite the president boasting about positive ratings.
